title: Snakes & Ladders: track + dice + triggered effects
description: Classic track game. Roll d6, advance along track, land on snake head = slide to tail, land on ladder bottom = climb to top. First to position 100 wins. Validates: track zone type, dice rolling (server authority), perturber effects triggered by position (snake/ladder as cycle or transfer effects), shared single track with multiple players. Good test of track zones which exist in the engine but have never been exercised with actual gameplay.
close_reason: Snakes & Ladders playable with 19 tests. First game to exercise TrackZone. Covers: track movement, d6 dice simulation, snake slide-down, ladder climb-up, overshoot bounce-back, exact-100 win, ladder-to-win, multiple tokens on same position, deterministic game flow.
